submit.doc: Submit a form response as an anonymous user. Reads the form schema from the node configuration file, inserts the submission into the form-specific database table (named form_NODE_ID), sends an email notification to configured backoffice recipients (owner or admin hub members), and sends an acknowledgement email to the submitter. Automatically enriches data with submission timestamp, user-agent, and geolocation if configured in the form schema.

data.description: Form submission payload. Field names and validation are governed by the form schema defined in the node configuration file. May include fields such as email, contact_name, and any custom fields defined by the form creator. The schema also controls automatic enrichment of ctime (timestamp), ua (user agent), and geoloc (geolocation) fields.

returns.description: The MFS node object representing the form file after successful submission

id.description: Node ID of the form file

file_name.description: Name of the form node file

mfs_root.description: Root MFS path where the form node resides

errors.message: Failed to read form configuration file or insert submission into database
Failed to send backoffice notification or acknowledgement email

browse.doc: Retrieve paginated form submissions from the form-specific database table (named form_NODE_ID). Results are ordered by creation time descending, with a fixed page size of 20 records. Requires write permission on the hub.

page.description: Page number for pagination. Each page returns up to 20 records ordered by ctime descending. Defaults to 1 if not provided.

returns.description: Array of form submission records from the form-specific table, ordered by ctime descending. Page size is fixed at 20.

ctime.description: Unix timestamp of when the submission was created

ua.description: User agent string of the submitter (if captured by schema), e.g. vendor/model/type or os/browser/version

geoloc.description: Geolocation of the submitter (if captured by schema), e.g. City, Region, Country

errors.message: Failed to query form submissions table

update.doc: Update a single configuration field in the form node JSON file. Reads the current configuration, sets conf[name]=value if both name and value are provided, then writes the updated configuration back to the file. Requires owner permission on the hub.

name.description: Name of the configuration field to update (e.g. recipients, schema, keys). If not provided, no field is modified and the current configuration is returned as-is.

value.description: New value to assign to the configuration field identified by name. The value type depends on the specific field being updated.

returns.description: The complete updated form configuration object as written to the node JSON file

schema.description: Form field schema definitions controlling data capture and enrichment

recipients.description: Email notification recipients configuration (array of emails or role strings such as owner or admin)

keys.description: Key configuration for the form, including the primary key field name

errors.message: Failed to read or write the form configuration file

info.doc: Retrieve the form configuration from the node JSON file. Returns the complete configuration object including schema, recipients, and key settings. Requires admin permission on the hub.

returns.description: The complete form configuration object read from the node JSON file

schema.description: Form field schema definitions controlling which fields are captured and enriched (e.g. ctime, ua, geoloc)

recipients.description: Email notification recipients configuration (array of emails or role strings such as owner or admin)

keys.description: Key configuration for the form, including the primary key field name

errors.message: Failed to read the form configuration file from the node MFS path
